_notes: Each tower has three levels; 'cost' is the price of that level (build cost for level 1, upgrade cost after). Ranges and radii are world units (one grid cell is 2). kind: projectile | cone | chain | beam | aura. Effects: slow [fraction, seconds], freeze / stun [chance, seconds], burn [damage per second, seconds], poison [damage per second, seconds, armor shred], chain [targets, jump radius, falloff], ramp [max multiplier, gain per second], crit [chance, multiplier], impale [extra targets, radius, damage fraction], aura {damage, rate, range bonus}.

arrow.name: Arrow Spire
arrow.description: Cheap, fast and reliable. Shreds light creeps; arrows glance off heavy plate.

levels.name: Hawkeye Spire
levels.perk: Twin Shot: looses arrows at two targets. 20% chance to strike for 2.5x.

cannon.name: Cannon Bastion
cannon.description: Slow shells that burst on impact. Cracks heavy armor and flattens packs. Cannot hit flyers.

levels.name: Bombard Bastion
levels.perk: Concussion: 25% chance to stun everything in the blast for 0.6s.

frost.name: Frost Obelisk
frost.description: Low damage, but every shard chills a small area. Slowed creeps spend longer under your other towers.

levels.name: Glacier Obelisk
levels.perk: Deep Freeze: 12% chance to freeze creeps solid for 1s.

ember.name: Ember Brazier
ember.description: Short range, but its jet of flame scorches every creep in front of it and leaves them burning. Burns through wards.

levels.name: Inferno Brazier
levels.perk: Wildfire: a wider jet and a far hotter burn.

storm.name: Storm Coil
storm.description: Lightning that leaps from creep to creep. Tears through ethereal things; wards shrug it off.

levels.name: Tempest Coil
levels.perk: Tempest: arcs through six creeps and barely weakens between jumps.

venom.name: Venom Thorn
venom.description: Poison ignores armor, strips it away and stops regeneration. Spreads its darts across fresh targets.

levels.name: Plague Thorn
levels.perk: Contagion: a poisoned creep that dies infects the creeps around it.

prism.name: Sun Prism
prism.description: A focused beam that grows hotter the longer it holds one target. Your answer to ogres and bosses.

levels.name: Solar Prism
levels.perk: Sunlance: ramps to 4x damage and ignores half of the target's armor.

ballista.name: Sky Ballista
ballista.description: Very long range, heavy bolts, slow to reload. Deals double damage to anything that flies.

levels.name: Skybreaker
levels.perk: Impale: the bolt punches through to two more creeps. 25% chance to strike for 2x.

banner.name: War Banner
banner.description: Does not attack. Towers in its aura hit harder. Auras do not stack: the strongest one counts.
